The **Super Bowl Most Valuable Player Award**, or **Super Bowl MVP**, is presented annually to the [most valuable player](Most_valuable_player "Most valuable player") of the [Super Bowl](Super_Bowl "Super Bowl"), the [National Football League](National_Football_League "National Football League")'s (NFL) championship game. The winner is chosen by a panel of 16 [football](American_football "American football") writers and broadcasters, and, since [Super Bowl XXXV](Super_Bowl_XXXV "Super Bowl XXXV") in 2001, fans voting electronically. The media panel's ballots count for 80 percent of the vote tally, while the viewers' ballots make up the other 20 percent.[[1]](Super_Bowl_Most_Valuable_Player_Award#cite_note-fan-1)[[2]](Super_Bowl_Most_Valuable_Player_Award#cite_note-2) The game's viewing audience can vote on the Internet or by using cellular phones;[[1]](Super_Bowl_Most_Valuable_Player_Award#cite_note-fan-1) Media voters are asked to vote with about five minutes remaining in the game, but are allowed to change their mind when the game ends. They can nominate one player from each team, with instructions to count their vote for the player on the winning team.[[3]](Super_Bowl_Most_Valuable_Player_Award#cite_note-3) Voters cannot select an entire unit.[[4]](Super_Bowl_Most_Valuable_Player_Award#cite_note-4)

The Super Bowl MVP has been awarded annually since the game's inception in 1967. Through 1989, the award was presented by *[SPORT](Sport_(US_magazine) "Sport (US magazine)")* magazine.[[5]](Super_Bowl_Most_Valuable_Player_Award#cite_note-presenters-5) [Bart Starr](Bart_Starr "Bart Starr") was the MVP of the first two Super Bowls. Tom Brady is the only player to have won five Super Bowl MVP awards (four with the [New England Patriots](New_England_Patriots "New England Patriots") and one with the [Tampa Bay Buccaneers](Tampa_Bay_Buccaneers "Tampa Bay Buccaneers")); [Joe Montana](Joe_Montana "Joe Montana") won three and four other players—[Bart Starr](Bart_Starr "Bart Starr"), [Terry Bradshaw](Terry_Bradshaw "Terry Bradshaw"), [Eli Manning](Eli_Manning "Eli Manning"), and [Patrick Mahomes](Patrick_Mahomes "Patrick Mahomes")—have won the award twice.[[8]](Super_Bowl_Most_Valuable_Player_Award#cite_note-8) Starr and Bradshaw are the only ones to have won it in back-to-back years.
